text: @hunterchcl/dsh-usage-meter README · dsh-usage-meter：> **UI language**: All UI copy follows the language selected in DSH (中文 / English). Switch it live in DSH Settings → General → Language; when unset, it follows your browser language.

@hunterchcl/dsh-usage-meter README · Features：- Settings page "Balance / Usage": balance details plus **pricing settings**: - A peak/off-peak pricing toggle. When enabled, every request is priced by the time window it occurred in, giving accurate amounts even when a conversation spans peak and off-peak windows. - (Same conversation as above, but with the peak/off-peak toggle on. Pricing the whole conversation with either the peak or the off-peak rate alone would be wrong, because it spans both windows.) - Usage is priced by the window at the **time the request occurred**; only the official API is supported for now. Unmatched models only show token counts, not amounts.

@hunterchcl/dsh-usage-meter README · Layout：```
dsh-usage-meter/
  package.json     plugin package declaration
  cordis.patch.yml bundle patch: mounts this plugin as a Cordis host plugin
  host.js          host ESM: TypertRemoteService RPC (balance/usage/pricing)

@hunterchcl/dsh-usage-meter README · Install：**1. Direct install:**

Clone this repo locally, then run its `install.ps1`:
```powershell
cd <plugin directory>
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```
**2. Install via npm:**

Run in PowerShell:
```
dsh plugin --profile web add @hunterchcl/dsh-usage-meter
```
Requires pnpm and dsh to be installed.

@hunterchcl/dsh-usage-meter README · Uninstall：Run `uninstall.ps1`:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\uninstall.ps1            # keep local data
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\uninstall.ps1 -RemoveData # also delete usage/pricing data
```
Or via pnpm:
```
dsh plugin --profile web remove @hunterchcl/dsh-usage-meter
```

@hunterchcl/dsh-usage-meter README · Notes & Limitations：- Usage is a local estimate (based on persisted usage records in the DSH session event log: `assistant/chunk` and `assistant/message`), for reference only — not a platform bill; the DeepSeek Open Platform is authoritative.
- Opening a session computes its full historical usage (including records from before this plugin was installed), priced by the peak/off-peak window at the time each request occurred.
- If you later run `pnpm install` manually in the profile directory, it may clean up local plugin directories not declared in `dependencies`; if that happens, re-run `install.ps1`.

DSH Usage Meter 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的余额与用量插件。它通过会话标题栏组件和设置页展示当前会话的 token 用量、估算金额及 DeepSeek 官方账户余额，并可按模型配置价格和峰谷时段价格。用量从 DSH 会话事件中汇总，用户可在设置页调整计价。余额查询需要配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，并向 DeepSeek 官方余额接口发起请求；会话用量估算在本地计算。

DSH Usage Meter adds a session header widget and settings page to the DSH web client. It summarizes session token usage and estimated cost from DSH events, with configurable model and peak/off-peak prices. It can show DeepSeek account balance using DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
我想在会话里看到这次对话大概花了多少 token 和钱。
怎么快速查看 DeepSeek API 账户还剩多少余额？
DSH Usage Meter 的功能「会话用量与费用估算」：在会话标题栏显示当前会话的 token 用量和估算金额，悬停可查看各模型的输入缓存命中、未命中与输出明细。
DSH Usage Meter 查询官方余额时需提供 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，并向 api.deepseek.com 发送带授权信息的请求；会话用量则从 DSH 本地会话事件计算。
